description: Policy events for the AI / Automation Trust Zone (VLAN 50, AI_AUTOMATION, 10.50.0.0/24). Supports the five-signal correlation model: human identity (delegating_user) + workload identity (workload_identity) + tool invocation (tool_name, mcp_server) + network flow (source, destination, protocol) + firewall decision (action, policy_id). Tool invocation fields are optional and are only populated when application-layer telemetry (agent or MCP audit logs) is available. The network layer alone cannot determine whether an AI prompt or tool invocation was malicious; it can only report that a network policy decision was made. Correlation of all five signals happens in an external SIEM.

action.description: Required. The firewall or ACL decision.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Opaque identifier for joining the network event with agent or MCP audit records.

delegating_user.description: Optional. Human identity that delegated the task to the agent, where application-layer telemetry provides it.

destination.description: Required. Where the traffic was directed.

event_type.description: Required. Fixed value for this event family.

mcp_server.description: Optional. Identity of the MCP server involved in the tool invocation, where application-layer telemetry provides it.

message.description: Required. Human-readable summary. Must not contain secrets, prompts, or tool payloads.

network_zone.description: Optional. Zone label; AI zone events use AI_AUTOMATION.

policy_id.description: Required. Identifier of the firewall rule or ACL ACE that made the decision, for example AI_EGRESS_DENY.

severity.description: Required. Severity assigned at the source.

source.description: Required. The AI workload that originated the traffic.

device.description: Optional. Device that generated the event, for example firewall.example.

zone.description: Optional. Source zone for AI events.

timestamp.description: Required. RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.

tool_name.description: Optional. Name of the tool invoked by the agent, where application-layer telemetry provides it. Absence means no application-layer telemetry was available, not that no tool was used.

vlan.description: Optional. Source VLAN ID; AI zone events use 50.

workload_identity.description: Required. The non-human workload identity responsible for the traffic, for example an AI agent runner name.
